description: NHFLOW hydrostatic semi-implicit with density (A 620 1, linear equation of state): a stratified lake at rest over a steep ridge (10 km, 100 m deep, ridge 80 m high with slopes of 0.08, 200 x 20 sigma layers). Salinity 31 - 5 tanh((z - 50)/20) given at 41 levels (A 611), no diffusion. The pressure gradient of Shchepetkin and McWilliams (A 622 1) on the sigma layers: the spurious velocity stays below 1 mm/s over days (two-term form about 3 mm/s). The tracers are split around the momentum (forward-backward) and have the vertical TVD correction (A 613 2, the default with A 620).
covers: the split tracer step (phases 1 and 2), the vertical TVD correction (A 613 2)
A 611 profile from a list of levels
internal wave speed in the time step
